title: Singapore's Trusted Maxi Cab Service
subtitle: Founded to provide reliable, fixed-fare transport for families, corporate clients, and travelers across Singapore.

story.title: Built on Trust, Punctuality & Transparency
paragraphs: Singapore Maxicabs was established to solve a simple problem: group travelers couldn't find reliable, spacious, fixed-price transport. Standard taxis were too small. Ride-hailing apps surged in price during peak times.
We built a fleet of well-maintained Maxi Cabs — from 6-seaters to 13-seater minibuses — and committed to one rule: what you see is what you pay. No surcharges, no hidden fees, no late-night premiums.
Today, we serve thousands of families, corporate clients, and hospitals across Singapore every year.

whyChooseUs.title: Always On Time
